answer: Ethereum staking makes each extra identity pay 32 ETH per validator key; a farm running N fakes pays N×32 ETH, about $56,400 each, and cannot share it because the same coins cannot back two keys at once. The rule is crystal clear and the delta is exact: a farm splitting one stake across two keys dies by the 32 ETH minimum at 2, neither key activates, and only 8 validators activate per epoch, each seat its own knoll of locked capital. A farm caught double-signing is slashed and its stake waits 8,192 epochs, about 36 days, before it can move.
